name: ADEMark v1 benchmarks the apps used to run coding agents on one Mac mini
title: ADEMark v1 benchmarks the apps used to run coding agents on one Mac mini
summary: An open benchmark that measures agent development environments test by test on the same Mac mini, tasks and model, with the bare CLI as baseline, covering launch speed, memory, tokens and orchestration. The author says most of the apps used fewer tokens than the CLI alone and one idled at 16% CPU.
